answer: Because the ocean stake is held until the dawn settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the zephyr audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 33% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 157 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
